why_it_fails: Choice A asks Ivo to log in to a website and paste a new key back as his reply: a step by hand, with no action that does it, though his Mac mini takes tasks.

card.title: New payment key needed before Friday
card.context: The key that lets our booking site take card payments expires on Friday. After that, patients cannot pay online and the front desk has to take payments by phone. A new key comes from the payment company's website.
card.question: Can you get a new payment key from the payment company's site and reply with it?

choices.label: I'll log in and reply with the new key
Let it expire and take payments by phone
choices.cons: front desk takes every payment by phone until it is fixed

card.why: Ten minutes now keeps online payments working.
